conviction_note: Q3 numbers are new: no trading update or profit warning since the 9 Jul H1 report, and no numerical 2026 guide that could be changed, so abs_move_pct is 6.0. That sits between the stage's 7% base for new numbers and this name's own results-day median of about 4%. The one company-level lean is the SSB 47.19 store-sales series, which has tracked the Europris chain within about 2pp for five quarters and reads -0.3% for Q3 against a +10.7% LFL comp. Scaled -0.96 against an impact_sum of -0.7: the two agree in sign, and the gap is the reaction history (9 of 12 results days fell), which moves p_up and not the findings.

findings.finding: SSB's store-sales value index for NACE 47.19 (Norwegian non-food general stores, Europris's category) reads -0.3% yoy for Q3 2026 (Jul +0.3%, Aug -2.0%, Sep +0.7%) after +9.5% in Q3 2025. Over five quarters the series has tracked the Europris chain closely (Q2 26: -0.9% vs chain -0.5%; Q3 25: +9.5% vs LFL +10.7% and segment Norway +11.6%; Q3 24: +2.7% vs LFL +2.9%). That implies roughly flat Norwegian chain sales against the toughest comp of the year and operating deleverage in segment Norway, whose Q3 2025 EBIT was 293m (+37.8%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (sales -2.8%, EBITDA 661 vs about 692 expected): -4.27%. Q3 2025 (sales beat, EBITDA 521 vs 526 consensus, after an 18% run-up): -12.35%. Q2 2025 solid: +6.94%. The name has fallen on 9 of 12 results days since 2023.

findings.why_not_priced: Jul and Aug were public and are likely in sell-side models, so this is partly priced. September came out this morning, the day before the print, and no Norwegian press item linking it to Europris was found. If the market had fully absorbed a flat Q3 top line against a +10.7% comp, the stock would not have rallied from 80.3 (Oct 6) to 85.9 (+4.6% over 20 days) into the print. The bar is unsourced, so sized small.
findings.independence: Partly contrary: Rusta Norway May-Jul 2026 LFL +3.2% (https://investors.rusta.com/sv/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2021/10/rusta-delarsrapport-q1-2026-2027-260909.pdf). Nothing independent points the same way.

findings.finding: The NOK strengthened sharply year on year through Q3 (USD/NOK about 9.3-9.6 vs about 10.0-10.06; EUR/NOK about 10.4-10.9 vs about 11.6-11.75). That cuts the NOK cost of Europris's USD/EUR-sourced imports, extending the gross-margin gain already visible in Q2 (+1.8pp; +1.6pp excluding unrealised FX) and adding to Q3 2025's +1.0pp.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 gross margin beat consensus (42.4% vs 41.2% per the Swedish wire) but EBITDA still missed on opex and the stock fell 4.27%. Margin beats have not carried this name by themselves.
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission and analysts know the currency, so it is mostly priced. What remains is how much of the gain Europris keeps rather than passes on through price leadership. SSB 47.19 volume (-0.6%) is close to value (-0.3%), so prices were not cut much, which argues it was kept. Sized small for the transmission step.
findings.independence: The Q2 report (https://s21.q4cdn.com/815767348/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Europris-ASA-Q2-2026-report.pdf) shows the margin effect already started, a company-level number. Clas Ohlson's September release attributes its currency effect to 'den starkare norska kronan' (https://placera.se/nyheter/-clas-ohlson-okar-forsaljningen-med-19-2026-10-07).

findings.finding: Norwegian non-food peers reported healthy recent demand: Clas Ohlson Norway September 2026 organic +8% (Sweden +11%, group +12%), and Rusta Norway May-Jul 2026 LFL +3.2%. This is mild evidence against a weak Norwegian consumer, though both are narrower than the SSB category series.

findings.why_not_priced: Public monthly releases, so largely priced. Kept only because it qualifies the SSB lean: if Norwegian demand were broadly weak, these peers would show it, and they do not. That means the soft 47.19 print is more likely a comp or share effect specific to Europris's category.
findings.independence: Rusta Q1 2026/27, Norway LFL 'jämförbar tillväxt exkl. valutaeffekter till 3,2% (3,3%)' (https://investors.rusta.com/sv/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2021/10/rusta-delarsrapport-q1-2026-2027-260909.pdf)

findings.finding: Segment Sweden (ÖoB) in Q3 carries 10 more store remodels with temporary closures and a campaign shift away from low-margin consumables, and its sales translate into NOK about 10% lower (SEK/NOK about 0.94-0.97 vs about 1.06). Reported group sales will therefore fall yoy even with a flat Norway, though the company guided to this weight.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Sweden EBIT loss was flat in Q2 2026 (-34 vs -34) and the stock fell 4.27% that day on the group EBITDA miss.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it sits inside what the company guided ('expected to continue to weigh on profitability in the near term') and the FX is public. Sized toward 0. What is left is the headline optics of a reported sales decline.

language_note: The load-bearing series is Norwegian. SSB's varehandelsindeks, by NACE 47.19 'Butikkhandel med bredt vareutvalg ellers', is published in Norwegian, and no English source tied it to Europris.

The Norwegian DNB Nyheter 'Dagens aksjetips' pages carried the only sourced past consensus (Q3 2025 EBITDA consensus 526m; Q1 2026 cons 307m) and the note that Q3 2025 had been preceded by rising expectations and an 18% run-up. No English source had either.
The Swedish sources (Clas Ohlson's country table on inderes.se; Rusta's Swedish-only Q1 report) gave the Norway-specific peer numbers that English wire summaries omitted.
The issuer's own filings (NewsWeb, Q2 report) are English-first and the Norwegian side added nothing to them; no resultatvarsel exists.
lessons_applied: 'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series': the Clas Ohlson / Rusta peer read-across was cut from +0.3 to +0.1, because the broader SSB 47.19 category series, which tracks Europris directly, points the other way

'You were right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 5.0 to 6.0, since the Q3 numbers are new with no pre-release. The name's own sold-beat history was left in p_up (42) rather than used to shrink the size
